## fix(core): Skip unknown fixedCollection keys instead of throwing

In getNodeParameters, the multipleValues branch of fixedCollection handling now skips keys that have no matching option instead of throwing 'Could not find property option', matching the single-value branch. The option lookup now happens once per key, before the inner loop, so no empty array is emitted for the skipped key. Added a unit test for it.

- 1 source file(s), 1 test file(s), 49 changed lines
- `packages/workflow/src/node-helpers.ts`
